basic_info.description: This luxurious condo is larger than most single family homes in Mission terrace. With 3 bedrooms and 2-bath, this spacious condo seamlessly blends contemporary design with everyday comfort. The spacious open floor plan includes a large corner living room and a dining area lined with bay windows and anchored by a cozy gas fireplace. Adjacent to the living space is a well-appointed U-shape kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, new quartz counters, new sink and faucet, and ample storage. The bedrooms are tucked away at the back of the home, offering privacy and tranquility. The primary suite boasts dual closets and an en-suite bathroom with a separate shower and a luxurious soaking tub. The additional bedrooms are conveniently separated by a second bathroom. This home is move-in ready with a freshly painted interior, new carpet, crown molding, recessed lighting, full-sized stacked laundry, and a private outdoor garden with pond & water feature. A deeded parking space adds the final touch to this thoughtfully designed home. Just a few blocks to both Glen Park and Balboa Park, BART, City College of SF, and the Outer Mission commercial district. Easy access to freeways and MUNI.
